gates.name: judge_facts
gates.detail: factual risk 2/10: The math is technically accurate at 8% compounded monthly, but presenting $1.7 million in 40 years without adjusting for inflation is highly misleading. At a standard 3% inflation rate, $1.7M in 40 years only has the purchasing power of about $535,000 today.
